bio.text: Richard Neal represents Massachusetts's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; he was first elected in 1988 and joined the Ways and Means Committee in 1993.
He chaired the Ways and Means Committee beginning in January 2019.
He was born in Worcester and raised in Springfield, where he was a high school teacher, city councilor, and mayor from 1984 to 1988.
He holds a bachelor's degree in political science from American International College and a master's in public administration from the University of Hartford.
